nodes.label: Server and Client Boundary
nodes.rationale: Database-bound modules must never enter client components, and shared values must live in leaf modules so Next.js client references are not mistaken for data.

nodes.label: TOTP Secret Server Boundary
nodes.rationale: The browser receives only a current one-time code and expiry; the stored Base32 secret is never readable back.

nodes.label: Coolify-Managed Traefik and TLS
nodes.rationale: Normal Coolify Compose deployment attaches the proxy and manages the domain, certificates and HTTPS redirect, so Compose intentionally omits proxy labels and published host ports.

nodes.label: Idempotent Administrator Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: The first start creates exactly one administrator only when users is empty; all later starts leave account and password data untouched.

nodes.label: Single-Container Coolify Architecture
nodes.rationale: A single multi-stage Bun container plus Compose is sufficient; there is no initializer service, separate database, host port or hand-written Traefik routing.

nodes.label: Single-Replica SQLite Operation
nodes.rationale: The SQLite database and local files share one persistent volume and must not be written by multiple application replicas.

nodes.label: Folded Date Axis
nodes.rationale: Sparse absences are located in a calendar, so folding the date axis at week boundaries preserves weekdays and avoids mostly empty Gantt lanes.

nodes.label: Calendar Grid Selection Gesture
nodes.rationale: Dragging on calendar cells can only mean selecting dates, removing the collision with time-entry dragging on Tagesbahn.

nodes.label: One Frame for All Routes
nodes.rationale: Employee and management pages should not split into different header and navigation grammars when they express the same headline-and-record structure.

nodes.label: Yearly Week Resolution
nodes.rationale: A year answers which weeks and how much, not which exact day, so it uses 52 or 53 week columns rather than shrinking 365 days.

nodes.label: ClockBar Deckung
nodes.rationale: The persistent clock strip withdraws facts already visible in today's header and restores them once the header scrolls away, keeping one fact in one place.

nodes.label: Der gestempelte Tag
nodes.rationale: The workday itself is the primary interface, with a horizontal visual grammar reused from daily detail through team overview.

nodes.label: Single Semantic Component Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: One component owns each visual grammar: Tagesbahn for days, Monatsgitter for months, PersonenTafel for person-number tables, and Sinnbild for icons.

nodes.label: Authored Motion Budget
nodes.rationale: Motion is reserved for time, rare state changes and continuity; ordinary transitions reuse tokens and all motion is reduced-motion gated.

nodes.label: One-Frame Rule
nodes.rationale: A route changes the contents of Kopf, Bühne, Belege and rail but never their topology, keeping employee and management surfaces in one product grammar.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking Side Effects
nodes.source_location: Project map: mail and Google calendar
nodes.rationale: Mail, calendar synchronization and audit logging run after the booking and never throw because ancillary delivery must not prevent the authoritative record from being written.

nodes.label: Near-Zero Daily Effort
nodes.rationale: Clocking is repeated many times each day and must remain a one-glance, one-click action instead of becoming a form.

nodes.label: The Record Is the Product
nodes.rationale: Completeness and correctness of payroll-relevant hours outrank convenience features, and corrections and approvals must remain trustworthy.

nodes.label: Two Audiences, One Truth
nodes.rationale: Employees and management see different scopes and controls but read from the same authoritative record.

nodes.label: Cheerful Customer-Support Persona
nodes.rationale: The headset, exaggerated grin, thumbs-up gesture, bright work shirt, and coffee mug combine into a playful, energetic calling or customer-support avatar.

nodes.label: Abwesenheit as a Span Record
nodes.rationale: A period record preserves that multiple calendar days belong to one absence and avoids repetitive day-by-day entry.

nodes.label: Antrag and Meldung Distinction
nodes.rationale: Urlaub and Freizeitausgleich request approval, while Krank and Fortbildung report facts; treating them as one flat choice erased governance and meaning.

nodes.label: Google Absence Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Effective absences are reconciled as a projection rather than tracked per row because §9 processing can delete and recreate leave rows.

nodes.label: Dated Rate Tier Frozen on Submission
nodes.norm_label: dated rate tier frozen on submission

nodes.label: Scrollable Computing Dialog
nodes.source_location: Craft notes that came out of the build
nodes.rationale: Editors whose contents grow with their input must scroll because the Astryx dialog viewport otherwise clips the save action.

nodes.label: Die Reise rechnet sich selbst
nodes.rationale: Departure, return, purpose and destination are entered once; duration and per-diem amounts are derived live to remove payroll errors from hand calculation.

nodes.label: Exact Redirect URI Matching
nodes.source_location: What you get from the MedArbeiter side

nodes.label: State-Bound CSRF Protection
nodes.source_location: Send the browser to the authorize endpoint

nodes.label: Single-Use Code Replay Protection
nodes.rationale: A second redemption revokes the first token, so callbacks must consume a code exactly once and remain idempotent across refreshes.

nodes.label: Health-and-Progress Brand Symbol
nodes.rationale: The heart and EKG imagery communicate health, while the rising arrow adds progress or growth to the compact black-and-gold brand mark.

nodes.label: Spesen sind kein Gold
nodes.rationale: Gold is reserved for worked time and the primary action, so money and travel-absence measurement use primary ink and stone.

nodes.label: Gold-Is-Work Rule
nodes.rationale: Brand gold has one semantic meaning—worked time and the primary action—so it cannot also encode status, warnings, money or decoration.

nodes.label: Two-Stones Rule
nodes.rationale: Two classes of non-work information are separated by lightness within the stone palette instead of inventing an additional hue.

nodes.label: Affected-Record Audit Scope
nodes.source_location: In der Prüfung gefunden und behoben
nodes.rationale: Employee visibility is restricted to betroffen_id; including attempted actions on foreign records leaked their descriptions to the actor.

nodes.label: Payload-Graded Visibility
nodes.rationale: Sensitive absence kinds must be removed in the server payload or SQL rather than hidden by client CSS, because anything delivered to the browser remains readable.

nodes.label: Client-App-Owned Session
nodes.source_location: How to use what you got
nodes.rationale: The access token exists only for one userinfo call; the client app creates its own session and does not retain the token.

nodes.label: Authoritative Rights Snapshot
nodes.source_location: How to use what you got

nodes.label: Named-Rights Authorization
nodes.rationale: Roles are permission bundles and every action checks a named right so per-account additions work without hardcoded role gates.

nodes.label: Gold-Needs-An-Edge Rule
nodes.rationale: Fixed brand gold cannot reach 3:1 on light grounds, so a bronze inset hairline supplies the perceptible boundary for every meaning-carrying gold surface.
